pricing.faq_cost_a: It depends on the model and the length of the conversation. A short exchange on a fast model costs a handful of credits; longer context and larger models cost more. Every deduction is itemised in your billing history.
pricing.faq_cost_q: How much does a message cost?
pricing.faq_expiry_a: No. Credits stay on your account until you spend them.
pricing.faq_models_a: Each persona is configured with a specific model — OpenAI, Anthropic or any OpenAI-compatible provider. The model in use is shown on every persona page.
pricing.faq_models_q: Which AI models do you use?
pricing.faq_refund_a: Unused credits can be refunded within 14 days of purchase. Contact support with your order reference.
pricing.no_gateway: No payment gateway is configured. Add Stripe or PayPal keys to enable checkout.
pricing.passes_subtitle: Time-boxed access passes — unmetered chat for an hour, a day, or a week. No ongoing commitment.
pricing.passes_title: Just need it for a bit?
pricing.plans_subtitle: Recurring credits on a schedule that suits you — weekly, monthly or yearly.
pricing.subtitle: Credits are deducted per message based on real token usage. No subscription, no expiry, no surprise invoices.
